profile.name: Tessa Marquardt
profile.subline: Remote data-analyst roles for a bootcamp graduate · Tailored to your resume · Board assumes remote-only
profile.recentRole: Sweetgrass Grill — General Manager, Dillon MT (2021–2026)
profile.stack: Python, SQL, Power BI, Excel, forecasting projects, P&L management
profile.target: Remote data or operations analyst · anywhere in the US
profile.summary: With no degree and no office nearby, the realistic doors are remote analyst and operations roles that hire on portfolio and work history. The new-grad programs on this board want a bachelor's, so they are out; the remote roles and the suggested remote-first employers are the list.
profile.applyNow: Stripe's Fraud Patterns Analyst and CrowdStrike's Falcon Complete Analyst I are remote and do not name a degree; everything in Utah would mean moving.
profile.watchLater: Keep building the portfolio; a Microsoft PL-300 certification would help with the Power BI roles.
